defaults.description: Suggested values the user can change. Same keys as the enforced settings.

enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no labels are shown anywhere.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules { id, pattern, env, label, enabled }. First match wins. Pattern: exact host, *.wildcard host, host:port, URL prefix (https://x.com/admin*), host/path, or /regex/.

environments.description: Environments { id, name, short, color, textColor ("" = automatic), confirmSubmit, ribbon, titlePrefix, favicon, badge }.

style.description: Page indicator style: ribbon (corner ribbon), bar (full-width bar) or frame (coloured border around the page).

position.description: Corner for the ribbon or frame tag: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. The bar uses the top or bottom edge.

size.description: Indicator size: small, medium or large.

titleFormat.description: Text put in front of the tab title. Placeholders: {short}, {name}, {label}.

hideSeconds.description: Clicking the indicator hides it for this many seconds (0 = until the page is reloaded).

showRibbon.description: Show the page indicator (ribbon, bar or frame).

showTitlePrefix.description: Add the environment prefix to tab titles.

showFavicon.description: Tint the site favicon with the environment colour.

showBadge.description: Show the environment on the toolbar icon badge.

confirmSubmit.description: Ask "Are you sure?" before submitting forms on environments that have confirmation turned on.

ruleSources.description: URLs of JSON rule files ({ environments: [...], rules: [...] }) merged after the local rules.

remoteRefreshHours.description: How often remote rule files are fetched again (hours, 0 = only on demand).

shareRules.description: Push your own rules to the linked shared backend (Settings -> Shared data) when syncing.

brand.description: Enforced brand kit fields (locked in Settings -> Branding).

connection.description: Optional shared-data backend. type: none | webhook | rest | supabase.
